description: An Android activity class for displaying detailed information about a recipe, including image, title, description, ingredients, steps, and favorite toggle functionality.

classes.name: RecipeDetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that presents the detailed view of a recipe with UI components and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, loads recipe data, and sets click listeners.

methods.name: setFavIcon
methods.description: Updates the favorite icon and content description based on the favorite status.

methods.name: addBullet
methods.description: Inflates and adds a bullet point TextView to the specified container.

methods.name: addStep
methods.description: Inflates and adds a step view with a number and text to the specified container.
